name: Lithium Sandbox
description: Sandbox backend that executes agent commands inside a Lithium-managed Linux sandbox via the `w365a` CLI (default) or an alternative `wxc` CLI that wraps Lithium.

cli.label: CLI
cli.help: Which CLI to drive. `lithium` invokes the `w365a` binary directly; `wxc` uses the `wxc-exec` binary which hides sandbox lifecycle behind base64-encoded JSON exec.

binaryPath.label: Binary Path
binaryPath.help: Optional override for the CLI binary. Defaults to `w365a` when cli=lithium, or `wxc-exec` when cli=wxc.

image.label: Image
image.help: Lithium image id passed on sandbox create.

pool.label: Pool
pool.help: Lithium pool name passed on sandbox create.

shape.label: Shape
shape.help: Lithium shape passed on sandbox create.

extraCreateArgs.label: Extra Create Args
extraCreateArgs.help: Extra flags appended to the CLI create command.

workdir.label: Working Directory
workdir.help: Default working directory for commands run inside the sandbox. Defaults to /workspace.

wxcCapabilities.label: wxc appContainer Capabilities
wxcCapabilities.help: Capabilities forwarded under appContainer.capabilities for the AppContainer backend. Only applies when cli=wxc. Defaults to ["permissiveLearningMode"].

wxcContainment.label: wxc Containment Backend
wxcContainment.help: Which wxc-exec backend to use. `appcontainer` runs a Windows AppContainer; `wslc` runs a Linux container in WSL2 on the local Windows host; `lxc` runs an LXC container on a Linux host; `lithium` provisions a managed Lithium sandbox via the Lithium service. Only applies when cli=wxc. Defaults to appcontainer.

wslcImage.label: wslc Image
wslcImage.help: Container image used by the WSL container backend. Docker-style reference (e.g. `alpine:latest`, `ubuntu:24.04`). Only applies when wxcContainment=wslc.

lxcDistribution.label: lxc Distribution
lxcDistribution.help: LXC distribution name passed to lxc-exec (e.g. `alpine`, `ubuntu`). Only applies when wxcContainment=lxc.

lxcRelease.label: lxc Release
lxcRelease.help: LXC distribution release passed to lxc-exec (e.g. `3.20`, `24.04`). Only applies when wxcContainment=lxc.

lxcDestroyOnExit.label: lxc Destroy On Exit
lxcDestroyOnExit.help: If true, the LXC container is destroyed after each command. Only applies when wxcContainment=lxc.

lithiumPartnerId.label: Lithium Partner Id
lithiumPartnerId.help: Lithium partner identifier issued for your account. Required when wxcContainment=lithium.

lithiumPoolId.label: Lithium Pool Id
lithiumPoolId.help: Lithium pool to provision sandboxes from. Defaults to `default`. Only applies when wxcContainment=lithium.

lithiumImageId.label: Lithium Image Id
lithiumImageId.help: Lithium image to provision (e.g. `azlinuxnginxcmd`). Required when wxcContainment=lithium.

lithiumShapeName.label: Lithium Shape
lithiumShapeName.help: Lithium shape (sizing) such as `4c8g`. Required when wxcContainment=lithium.

lithiumMaxIdleSeconds.label: Lithium Max Idle (s)
lithiumMaxIdleSeconds.help: Idle timeout before Lithium reclaims the sandbox. Defaults to 3600. Only applies when wxcContainment=lithium.

lithiumMaxLifetimeSeconds.label: Lithium Max Lifetime (s)
lithiumMaxLifetimeSeconds.help: Hard lifetime cap for a Lithium sandbox. Defaults to 86400. Only applies when wxcContainment=lithium.

lithiumManagementTokenEnvVar.label: Management Token Env Var
lithiumManagementTokenEnvVar.help: Name of the environment variable carrying the Lithium management token. wxc-exec reads the token value from this env var at runtime. Defaults to `MXC_LITHIUM_MANAGEMENT_TOKEN`. Only applies when wxcContainment=lithium.

lithiumProxyTokenEnvVar.label: Proxy Token Env Var
lithiumProxyTokenEnvVar.help: Name of the environment variable carrying the Lithium proxy token. Defaults to `MXC_LITHIUM_PROXY_TOKEN`. Only applies when wxcContainment=lithium.

lithiumPorts.label: Lithium Ports
lithiumPorts.help: Port bindings exposed by the Lithium sandbox, each `{ port, policy: "Owner", protocol: "Http"|"Https" }`. Only applies when wxcContainment=lithium.

lithiumDestroyOnExit.label: Lithium Destroy On Exit
lithiumDestroyOnExit.help: If true, the Lithium sandbox is destroyed after the wxc-exec invocation completes. Defaults to true. Only applies when wxcContainment=lithium.

lithiumLauncherScript.label: Lithium Launcher Script
lithiumLauncherScript.help: Path to run_lithium_fleet.ps1 (the PowerShell wrapper that handles Entra/AAD auth and invokes wxc-exec). Required when wxcContainment=lithium.

lithiumTenantId.label: Lithium Tenant Id
lithiumTenantId.help: Entra/AAD tenant id for `az account get-access-token --tenant`. Required when wxcContainment=lithium.

lithiumPowerShellPath.label: PowerShell Binary
lithiumPowerShellPath.help: PowerShell executable used to run the launcher script. Defaults to `powershell.exe` (Windows PowerShell, also reachable from WSL via /init). Set to `pwsh` if you prefer PowerShell 7+. Only applies when wxcContainment=lithium.

lithiumEnvironment.label: Lithium Environment
lithiumEnvironment.help: Lithium service environment passed to the launcher (`test` or `int`). The launcher overrides experimental.lithium.apiEndpoint based on this. Defaults to test. Only applies when wxcContainment=lithium.

timeoutSeconds.label: Command Timeout Seconds
timeoutSeconds.help: Timeout for CLI control operations (create, inspect, destroy).
